name: Citizenship by Registration (Minor Dependants)

qualifying_event.description: A minor (18 or under) whose parent becomes a citizen of Saint Kitts and Nevis by marriage, residence, or investment may be registered as a citizen alongside that parent.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Parent's approved citizenship application/certificate; child's birth certificate proving the parent-child relationship.

requirements.blocker_text: Route applies to minors aged 18 and under.
Parent must be becoming a citizen via marriage, residence (naturalisation), or investment.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis -- Types of Citizenship: registration pathway for minors 18 and under whose parents became citizens by marriage, residence, or investment

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Kitts and Nevis' initial build. STATUS: DRAFT -- the source confirms this pathway exists and its basic eligibility gate, but gives no fee, process, or timeline detail; no secondary source was found to fill the gap, unlike this build's other draft routes. Modelled as a dependent-on-parent route via prerequisites rather than an independent one.
